howtos.title: Give the coding agent ownership of the codebase
howtos.what: Anthropic's Fable 5.2 line that made the model merge repeated code in about half of tries, versus under a tenth without it.
copy: This codebase is yours: what it's for and how it's built are your call, and you'll keep building on it.
howtos.whenToUse: When a coding agent is too cautious to improve or refactor existing code.

howtos.title: Plan with Fable 5.2, then build with Opus 5.5
howtos.what: A workflow to stretch limited Fable usage: use it only to plan and audit, then hand the plan to Opus to build.
copy: Use Fable only for planning and docs.
Have it audit the plan until it reaches highest confidence, with no clear gaps and no overengineering.
Make sure it writes out every step.
Hand the plan to Opus 5.5 to build.
howtos.whenToUse: When the premium model's usage limits run out faster than your build work.

howtos.title: Reset your agent setup at every major model drop
howtos.what: A two-step checklist so old instructions don't hold a new model back.
copy: Consider removing your existing skills and AGENTS.md files.
howtos.whenToUse: Right after a major model release, before you keep using your old agent setup.
